prompt: Where is the modal heading that says "INSTANT SOURCING PING" implemented?
Where is the storefront FAQ entry "Where do I find my purchases?" defined?
Where is the countdown timer shown for pending orders in the admin area implemented?
Where does the server verify the Cloudflare Turnstile captcha token?
Where is the logic that detects activation links and builds the copyable text for delivered credentials?
Where are the order and reservation state machines (valid status transitions) defined?
Where is the dedicated Telegram webhook endpoint route defined?
Where is the background music player component for the public site implemented?

On the reseller wallet page, trace what happens when the user starts a P2P top-up: which API route is called, which service allocates the unique centavos match, and which DB table stores the payment session?
In admin settings, when an admin adds or removes a staff member, which API route handles it and which DB table is written?
The public storefront vending floor shows dispensers/slots. Trace from the showcase component to the API route, the service, and the DB table that supplies the slot data.
Trace the forgot-password flow: which API route does the page submit to, and which auth function actually requests the recovery email?
When a user submits the restock notification form, which API route receives it and where does that route persist the request (which table/collection)?
When a customer archives an order from their vault drawer, which API route is called, which service handles it, and which table stores the archive records?
If I change the props of the TelegramLinkWidget component, which pages will be affected?
What pages use the CredentialRevealModal component, i.e. what breaks if I change its API?
Which files import the shared overlay layer (z-index) constants module? I want to change a layer value.
Which files render or import the restock alert modal component?
If I change the state machine module's transition rules, which inventory services depend on it?
Change the storefront hero button label "Explore 12 Dispensers" to "Browse All Dispensers".
In the restock alert modal, change the submit button text "Notify Me on Restock" to "Alert Me When Back".
On the storefront trust bar, rename the "Private Solo Access" title to "Exclusive Solo Access".
On the storefront trust bar, change the title "Immediate Delivery" to "Instant Delivery".
In the storefront buying help FAQ, change the question "How long do I have to pay?" to "How much time do I have to pay?".

check.pattern: question:s*"How much time do I have to pay?"
